# Cocxy Terminal

> Native macOS terminal for developers working with local AI coding agents. Real-time agent detection, encrypted Vault, inline code review, Markdown workspace, GPU rendering, remote workspaces, zero telemetry, and MIT license.

## Quick facts
- Version: 0.0.0
- License: MIT
- Platform: macOS 14.0+
- Source: https://github.com/salp2403/cocxy-terminal
- Telemetry: zero

## Important pages
- Home: https://cocxy.dev/
- Features: https://cocxy.dev/features.html
- Agents: https://cocxy.dev/features/agents.html
- Privacy: https://cocxy.dev/privacy.html
- Security: https://cocxy.dev/security.html
- Architecture: https://cocxy.dev/architecture.html
- Documentation: https://cocxy.dev/docs/

## Supported agents
- Claude
- Codex
- OpenCode
- Pi
- Cursor
- Gemini
- Rovo
- Copilot

- Qoder
